engineering.basis: fictional resource and energy budget; not a climate simulation
engineering.oxygenSource: local water; selected worlds retain substantial nitrogen and water inventories
engineering.hydrogenDestination: removed from the atmosphere; accounted export beyond the planetary gravity well, without returning it to surface oxygen
engineering.powerNote: distributed solar collection and fusion; process allowance is separate from basic construction, climate control and warp energy
engineering.thermalNote: orbital collection, external radiators and exported chemical energy require a separate heat balance; surface waste heat is not assumed harmless
engineering.initialConditionsNote: fictional selection assumptions: pre-existing nitrogen, water and partial abiotic oxygen; no claim of observed exoplanet atmospheres
